method: Full-field editorial translation with era-specific historical research; not an independent scholarly certification.

sourceExceptions.reason: Republican Congress interpreted contextually as Republican members of Congress, not Republican majority; 86th House was Democratic. Interpretation disclosed in annotation.

revisions.source: I will give a statement encouraging the State of Georgia to protect the safety of Mr. King, while criticizing him for participating in these inflammatory and illegal protests.
revisions.zh: 我会发表声明，敦促佐治亚州保护金先生的安全，同时批评他参与这些煽动性、非法的抗议。

revisions.source: We need more spending and lower interest rates, and we need to repeal the Taft-Hartley Act and put more money into the hands of the American people.
revisions.zh: 我们需要增加开支、降低利率，废除《塔夫脱—哈特利法》，让更多钱回到美国人民手中。

revisions.source: We must do better. Our present Administration has advocated a hard money policy which caused the recession of 1958 and left idle industrial capacity in our country.
revisions.zh: 我们必须做得更好。本届政府主张紧缩货币政策，造成1958年的衰退，使本国工业产能闲置。

revisions.source: We are on the right track economically. We can't deny that there was a recession in 1958, but the recovery has been strong and 1960 will see a very high rate of growth in this country.
revisions.zh: 我们的经济方向是正确的。不能否认1958年发生了衰退，但复苏势头强劲，1960年本国将实现很高的增长率。

revisions.source: The Eisenhower Administration has unfortunately failed to take any real action in undoing the excesses of the New Deal. I would like to see a more conservative Administration in power.
revisions.zh: 遗憾的是，艾森豪威尔政府没有采取任何实质行动，纠正新政的过度举措。我希望看到一个更加保守的政府执政。

revisions.source: I support this measure, and believe it would be greatly beneficial to millions of American workers.
revisions.zh: 我支持这项措施，相信它会使数百万美国劳动者大受裨益。

revisions.source: Our current minimum wage is sufficient in my opinion. The minimum wage is a necessary expedient but we shouldn't be increasing it so much that we cause unemployment.
revisions.zh: 在我看来，目前的最低工资已经足够。最低工资是必要的应对措施，但不应涨得太多，以致造成失业。

revisions.source: I believe a minimum wage is at the very least a bad economic idea, and possibly unconstitutional. I do not support this increase.
revisions.zh: 我认为，最低工资至少是一项糟糕的经济政策，也可能违宪。我不支持这次提高。

revisions.source: The last thing we need is a return to excesses and witch-hunts of the early 1950s. We need to keep ourselves focused on the external Communist threat.
revisions.zh: 我们最不需要的，就是重回1950年代初的过激做法和政治猎巫。我们应该集中关注外部的共产主义威胁。

revisions.source: We should always be concerned about internal subversion, but the external Soviet threat should be our primary focus at this point.
revisions.zh: 我们始终应该警惕内部颠覆，但现阶段应当主要关注苏联的外部威胁。

revisions.source: It's unfortunate that we've become less vigilant on the internal Communist threat in recent years. Espionage and infiltration of our government is as serious a threat as external Soviet action.
revisions.zh: 遗憾的是，近年来，我们对国内共产主义威胁的警惕有所放松。间谍活动和对政府的渗透，与苏联在国外的行动一样，是严重威胁。

revisions.source: We've seen some alarming things out of Cuba, but this isn't necessarily a lost cause. Cuba has not declared itself a Communist state and we should be making overtures to prevent that.
revisions.zh: 古巴出现了一些令人担忧的事，但不一定已无可挽回。古巴尚未宣布自己是共产主义国家，我们应该主动接触，防止它走到那一步。

revisions.source: We will defend our base at Guantanamo and do anything else that is necessary if Cuba continues its hostility. However, it is too early to make a conclusive determination at this point.
revisions.zh: 如果古巴继续敌视我们，我们将保卫关塔那摩基地，并采取其他一切必要措施。不过，目前还不宜作出最终判断。

revisions.source: What we've unfortunately seen in Cuba is the consequence of insufficient support for anti-Communist governments and movements. We need to be much more aggressive in our actions against the Castro government.
revisions.zh: 遗憾的是，古巴的情况，是对反共政府和运动支持不足的结果。我们需要采取远为积极的行动，对抗卡斯特罗政府。

revisions.source: We lost a lot of ground diplomatically after this event, and much of that could have been avoided had we issued a formal apology.
revisions.zh: 事件发生后，我们在外交上丢失了大量阵地。如果正式道歉，其中很大一部分损失本可避免。

revisions.source: A formal apology sounds a bit extreme, but we could certainly have expressed our regrets and perhaps saved the Paris Summit from collapse.
revisions.zh: 正式道歉听起来有些过头，不过我们确实可以表达遗憾，或许还能避免巴黎峰会破裂。

revisions.source: Absolutely not. We cannot show weakness in the face of the Soviet threat, and the Paris Summit collapsed from the intransigence of Nikita Khrushchev.
revisions.zh: 绝不应该。面对苏联威胁，我们不能示弱。巴黎峰会破裂，是尼基塔·赫鲁晓夫拒不让步造成的。

revisions.source: He absolutely did, and I would like to see further action to desegregate our schools and enforce our civil rights.
revisions.zh: 他做得完全正确。我希望进一步行动，废除学校的种族隔离，保障我们的公民权利。

revisions.source: I believe that Eisenhower did what he had to do in this case, to make sure the decisions of our Supreme Court are enforced.
revisions.zh: 我认为，在这件事上，艾森豪威尔为确保最高法院的判决得到执行，做了必须做的事。

revisions.source: We should have found a better way to resolve this issue, rather than intrude into the sovereignty of an American state.
revisions.zh: 我们本应找到更好的解决办法，而不是侵犯一个美国州的主权。

revisions.source: We need to make sure we don't overextend ourselves into new regions when the situation does not warrant it.
revisions.zh: 在局势没有必要时，我们必须确保不会在新的地区过度扩张承诺。

revisions.source: This is a situation that we need to watch carefully, and I am open to a variety of measures if necessary.
revisions.zh: 这是我们需要密切关注的局势。如有必要，我愿意考虑多种措施。

revisions.source: I believe we need to defend South Vietnam at all costs, whatever commitment of our forces that entails.
revisions.zh: 我认为，无论意味着投入多少兵力，我们都需要不惜一切代价保卫南越。

revisions.source: I would support the use of massive air strikes or tactical nuclear weapons to defend our ally, South Vietnam.
revisions.zh: 我会支持发动大规模空袭，或使用战术核武器，保卫我们的盟友南越。

revisions.source: Labor unions have been needlessly undermined by the Taft-Hartley Act, and by self-serving investigations from both parties. I will do anything I can as President to support our nation's laborers.
revisions.zh: 《塔夫脱—哈特利法》和两党谋取私利的调查，不必要地削弱了工会。作为总统，我会尽一切努力支持本国劳工。

revisions.source: I support unions and I oppose the excesses of leaders such as Jimmy Hoffa. Unions, cleansed of their corrupt elements, should play a central role in the American economy.
revisions.zh: 我支持工会，反对吉米·霍法等领导人的过度行为。清除腐败分子之后，工会应该在美国经济中发挥核心作用。

revisions.source: We should be vigilant against labor union excesses, and the Taft-Hartley Act was a good start. I believe that we should keep that law in place.
revisions.zh: 我们应该警惕工会的过度行为，《塔夫脱—哈特利法》是个不错的开端。我认为，应该保留这部法律。

revisions.source: We need to do anything we can to reduce the power of labor unions in this country, including a national right-to-work law.
revisions.zh: 我们需要尽一切努力削弱本国工会的权力，包括制定一部全国性的工作权法。

revisions.source: I believe that we need more vigilance in the area of defense, for both military equipment and for missile development. We currently have a missile gap with the Soviet Union.
revisions.zh: 在国防方面，无论军事装备还是导弹研制，我们都需要更加警惕。目前，我们与苏联之间存在导弹差距。

revisions.source: We can always find areas for improvement, but we have successfully defended the United States and our allies from numerous Communist threats over the past eight years.
revisions.zh: 我们总能找到改进的地方，但过去八年，我们已成功保卫美国及盟友，抵御了许多共产主义威胁。

revisions.source: In the final analysis, every dollar spent on defense is taken from more productive uses within our economy. I will look for ways to find common ground with the Soviet Union so that we can cut defense spending.
revisions.zh: 归根结底，国防每花一美元，就使经济中更有生产效益的用途少了一美元。我会寻求与苏联达成共识，以便削减国防开支。

revisions.source: We will campaign up and down New York and the Eastern Seaboard.
revisions.zh: 我们将在纽约州和东海岸各地竞选。

revisions.source: We will focus on the Midwest.
revisions.zh: 我们将集中争取中西部。

revisions.source: We will travel to California and the West Coast.
revisions.zh: 我们将前往加利福尼亚州和西海岸。

revisions.source: We will focus on Texas and the South.
revisions.zh: 我们将集中争取得克萨斯州和南方。

revisions.source: Alabama - Unpledged
revisions.zh: 阿拉巴马州——未承诺支持特定候选人的选举人

revisions.source: This might help you in the Deep South, but it will definitely not help with black and liberal turnout in other regions.
revisions.zh: 这也许有助于争取深南部，但肯定无助于提高其他地区黑人和自由派选民的投票率。

revisions.source: It's hard to sound too aggressive on the Cold War, but this might do it. A lot of people think this is an extreme idea.
revisions.zh: 在冷战问题上很难显得过于强硬，但这个主张可能做到了。许多人认为，这个想法太极端了。

revisions.source: This is the party line that people want to hear. Good luck this fall!
revisions.zh: 这是人们想听到的本党立场。祝你今年秋季好运！

revisions.source: This may be more accurate, given your record. Let's see how it flies with the voting public this fall.
revisions.zh: 考虑到你的政绩，这也许更贴切。看看今年秋季选民是否买账吧。

revisions.source: Good luck with your bold agenda for the future.
revisions.zh: 祝你面向未来的大胆施政计划顺利。

revisions.source: This line of reasoning could work, if voters don't find it too clever by half.
revisions.zh: 如果选民不觉得你聪明反被聪明误，这套说辞也许管用。

revisions.source: Your words of support help as LBJ begins campaigning in the South. He will cajole and strong-arm that region's politicians into disavowing the unpledged elector movement.
revisions.zh: 林登·约翰逊开始在南方竞选，你的支持之词起到了帮助。他会对当地政治人物软硬兼施，迫使他们公开否认支持未承诺选举人运动。

revisions.source: One ugly incident may not swing too many voters to your side, but any little bit helps late in a campaign.
revisions.zh: 一次丑陋的事件，也许不会使太多选民转向你，但竞选临近结束时，能多争取一点也好。

revisions.source: Nixon is better known than you are, you're a good debater, and you're telegenic. Why would you not want to debate him?
revisions.zh: 尼克松比你更知名，你擅长辩论，镜头前形象也好。为什么不愿与他辩论呢？

revisions.source: You've managed to come across as Nixon's equal in these debates, and that alone is a good start...
revisions.zh: 在这些辩论中，你成功地表现出与尼克松旗鼓相当，单是这一点，就是个不错的开端……

revisions.source: You are the clear winner in the first debate, and it shows in the sudden enthusiasm of your crowds.
revisions.zh: 你明显赢得了第一场辩论，竞选活动中人群突然高涨的热情，也说明了这一点。

revisions.source: The impulse is noble, but you come across as a little petty as you awkwardly read from these leaflets at your latest press conference.
revisions.zh: 出发点很高尚，但你在最近的记者会上，笨拙地读着这些传单，显得有点斤斤计较。

revisions.source: You might get away with this for awhile, but be careful that you don't let these attacks snowball.
revisions.zh: 暂时这么应对，也许还说得过去，但小心别让这些攻击越滚越大。

revisions.source: Giving this speech was a good idea. Many people were impressed, and it provided good material for future advertisements.
revisions.zh: 发表这篇演说是个好主意。许多人印象深刻，它也为后续广告提供了好素材。

revisions.source: This is an acceptable response, but it wouldn't have harmed you to be a little more bold.
revisions.zh: 这是个可以接受的回应，不过再大胆些也无妨。

revisions.source: It won't cripple your chances of winning the election, but there are some concerns about how passive you've been on addressing this issue.
revisions.zh: 这不会严重损害你的胜算，但有人担心，你处理这个问题时过于被动。

revisions.source: This will help you drive turnout in the northern states, and hurt a little in the South.
revisions.zh: 这有助于提高北方各州的投票热情，但会让你在南方略受损失。

revisions.source: This is a safe answer that won't hurt you too much with anybody.
revisions.zh: 这是个稳妥的回答，不会严重得罪任何一方。

revisions.source: This might not be the right answer in the case of Nixon. It comes off as overly aggressive, and if 8 years as Vice President is not enough experience, where does that leave you?
revisions.zh: 用来回应尼克松，这也许不合适。它显得过于咄咄逼人；如果当了八年副总统还不算经验足够，那你又算什么呢？

revisions.source: This will certainly galvanize your base, but it's hard to imagine that you can get national health insurance passed after the failures of Truman on this front.
revisions.zh: 这肯定会激发你的基本盘，但杜鲁门在这个问题上已经失败，很难想象你能让全国医疗保险获准通过。

revisions.source: National health insurance is not a Republican issue.
revisions.zh: 全国医疗保险不是共和党的议题。

revisions.source: This is exactly what your party wants to hear and will push for on this issue.
revisions.zh: 在这个问题上，这正是本党想听到、也会争取推动的主张。

revisions.source: You are definitely going against the Republican Congress on this issue, but it could work to your benefit.
revisions.zh: 在这个问题上，你确实与国会中的共和党人唱反调，但也可能对你有利。

revisions.source: This is really more of a Republican idea, and it's not like old-age health insurance is unpopular...
revisions.zh: 这其实更像共和党的主张，而且老年医疗保险又不是不受欢迎……

revisions.source: This is right in line with the goals of your party.
revisions.zh: 这完全符合本党的目标。

revisions.source: This is definitely an extreme stance for a Democrat to take.
revisions.zh: 对于民主党人来说，这无疑是一个极端立场。

revisions.source: You're taking a big chance by breaking with Eisenhower and advocating a pretty conservative position on this issue.
revisions.zh: 与艾森豪威尔决裂，在这个问题上主张相当保守的立场，你是在冒很大的险。

revisions.source: People want to see a President who is tough on Communism, but even some staunch anti-Communists feel that sending troops to such tiny and remote islands is ill-advised.
revisions.zh: 人们希望总统强硬对抗共产主义，但即便一些坚定的反共人士，也认为把军队派到如此偏远的小岛并不明智。

revisions.source: This is a good answer for this situation.
revisions.zh: 对于这个局面，这是个不错的回答。

revisions.source: Nixon is questioning your hesitation on this issue. Fortunately, however, the average voter has never heard of Quemoy and Matsu.
revisions.zh: 尼克松正质疑你在这个问题上的犹豫。幸好，普通选民从来没听说过金门和马祖。

revisions.source: Kennedy is questioning your hesitation on this issue. Fortunately, however, the average voter has never heard of Quemoy and Matsu.
revisions.zh: 肯尼迪正质疑你在这个问题上的犹豫。幸好，普通选民从来没听说过金门和马祖。

revisions.source: This position is a little too passive for those who want to see a tough, Cold War leader as President.
revisions.zh: 对于那些希望总统成为强硬冷战领袖的人，这个立场有点过于消极。

revisions.source: As a challenger in this election, it's better to point out problems in the foreign policy of Eisenhower, than to say it has been completely effective.
revisions.zh: 作为这次选举中的挑战者，指出艾森豪威尔外交政策的问题，比宣称它完全有效更好。

revisions.source: This is a good answer that supports the record and policies of yourself and Eisenhower.
revisions.zh: 这是个不错的回答，支持了你自己和艾森豪威尔的政绩与政策。

revisions.source: Not only does it undercut your claims as Eisenhower's successor, but it also offends Eisenhower personally when you criticize his foreign policy.
revisions.zh: 这不仅削弱了你作为艾森豪威尔继承人的说法，批评他的外交政策也会让他本人感到冒犯。

revisions.source: This is a good answer that should win support for you from Democrats.
revisions.zh: 这是个不错的回答，应该能为你赢得民主党人的支持。

revisions.source: This isn't a good response for the majority of your party.
revisions.zh: 对本党大多数人来说，这不是个好回应。

revisions.source: This is a good answer that should win support for you from Republicans.
revisions.zh: 这是个不错的回答，应该能为你赢得共和党人的支持。

revisions.source: This definitely helps you with the black and liberal vote in the north.
revisions.zh: 这确实有助于争取北方的黑人和自由派选民。
